capabilities: Set a minimum width for the active pane
Resize other panes to keep the active pane wide enough
Override the minimum width per view type
Customize layout via CSS snippets using an added class
extras: The README notes that more specific CSS rules from other sources may override the plugin's rules and shows a CSS snippet fix taken from an issue.
intentEvidence: This plugin is based on the blog post Set the Minimum Width of the Active Pane in Obsidian.
motivation: The README says the plugin is based on a blog post explaining how to set the minimum width of the active pane.
problem: Obsidian's pane splitting lets the active pane shrink too narrow when many panes are open, hurting readability.

relations.evidence: excalidraw: The view type used by plugin Excalidraw and Excalibrain.
excalidraw: The view type used by plugin Excalidraw and Excalibrain.

summary: Pane layout plugin that enforces a minimum width for the active pane by resizing other panes accordingly.
